author: KY-Programming
name: KY.Generator module
description: A custom KY.Generator module: the base assembly that users reference, the generator assembly the tool loads at run time, and an example project that generates with it.

moduleIdentifier.description: The module name with everything that is not valid in a C# identifier removed, for type names and the fluent action. A name like Acme.Hello gives AcmeHello, because IAcme.HelloWriteSyntax would not compile.

sdkVersion.description: Version of the KY.Generator packages to build against. Defaults to the version of the SDK this template came from - both halves of a module and the tool that loads them have to match. The default is written in by 'dotnet pack'; installing this template from the source folder instead of from the package leaves the placeholder, so pass the version explicitly then.

exampleFramework.description: Target framework of the example project. The module itself always targets netstandard2.0.
